brief:
The United States designated Palestine Action a terrorist organization, a move critics say endangers activists in Britain who have targeted properties linked to Trump and Israeli interests, Middle East Eye reported. The announcement came days before activists' campaign methods became public knowledge, according to the feed summary.

UK-based observers expressed concern that the American terror tag jeopardizes Palestine Action members operating in Britain, where the group is not legally classified as a terrorist entity. The timing of Washington's designation—preceding wider disclosure of the activists' targeting of Trump-connected Scottish property—has drawn scrutiny from those warning of unintended consequences for protesters engaged in lawful advocacy outside the United States.

title: US terror designation threatens UK Palestine Action activists
